title: Round 8 stream D: kills lie on the ground, F's amber flare sends the Yushi Rover, it brings the biomass home to the Yushi045 Bio-Pearls, whose sum is the bank (capped at 36,000 kg, a fourth pearl on the board); the SAI-92 stands on the new depot island
context: Owner, 2026-11-05, note 7 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-06-round-8-seven-notes-design.md, stream D): 'a new mechanic: the tank drops temporary flares like Isao, which dispatches the Yushi Rover to come collect the biomass (it is not automatic anymore), and it brings the biomass back to the Yushi045 biopearl, these are where the biomass is stored; the yushi rover is also a buildable unit, but not used for now'; note 5, 'we import new models' (the SAI-92 on the base); and 'tweak the existing game to fit the new models, for pacing and cost of units too'. Before: every kill paid the bank at the moment of death (economy.award from damageEnemy and the ram); no flare in the main game; the pearls, the rover and the SAI-92 were pinned (9b9171eb) but unused.
outcome: PURE RULES: src/domain/biomass-field.js (a pile a cell, aggregated, touched by drop and take, rotting after FIELD.decaySeconds 240 untouched, maxPiles 400 with the oldest rotting first, richest(reach) for the reference flagger), src/domain/rover-run.js (idle -> out -> harvest -> home -> unload | full -> idle; the turn on the spot at 0.8 rad/s before each road; the piles within reach 3 cells of the flare nearest first; a standing flare over reachable piles sends it back for the rest; piles it cannot reach are skipped per order; whole kilos at the rake and the pour), src/domain/bio-pearls.js (fill into the most room, fillAt the docked vessel first, spend from the fullest, settle(total): the economy's number is the truth), src/domain/economy.js (cap, setCap, award(..., { hold }) books the kill without banking it, deposit(kg) takes what fits; a credit over the cap is lost, ledger.lost; the ledger gains field, harvested, lost). Tests: test/biomass-field.mjs, test/rover-run.mjs, test/bio-pearls.mjs (with the economy's cap). IN THE GAME: src/fx/rover-glue.js owns the wiring (td-tab +11 lines, 5,340 of 5,450): payKill(bounty, opts, cell) replaces both kill-pay sites (damageEnemy, the ram in src/fx/enemy-step.js); LIVE only once the depot step's perk `depot` stands (printed after HUGIN at sector 1 on a bare page, standing on a skipped opening), so the opening's economy is untouched and the campaign board and the sim stay uncapped. F (src/platform/tank-input.js, CONTROLS_PAGE) drops an amber flare under the hull (src/fx/hull-flare.js: core, halo sprite, ground disc, the site ring at the rover's reach; 90 s, at most 3; NO PointLight: a light added in play changes every lit material's program). The rover (src/fx/rover.js) is a clone of the LOD1 driven by the author's runtime.js (wheels, suspension solved flat in its own metres off the holder, belt while raking, gauges, valve), the drawn rover chasing the run's point; one tier at every distance (LOD2 is a frozen pose). The gate opens for it (story-base nearAlso). The pearls' fill shader through the author's yushi045 runtime.js on both tiers (src/fx/bio-pearls.js, refitted when a print swaps materials). Piles: one instanced olive mesh (src/fx/biomass-piles.js). Readouts: FIELD n kg beside the bank, ROVER · <state> n KG on the hull console (STORAGE FULL red), ON THE GROUND on the debrief's biomass tile (report.biomass.ground when any), Isao's rover_flare hint the first time 300 kg lie on the ground, storage_full once. THE BASE: island `depot` 36 x 16 m at (-70, -78), stage 8 (stream C moves it by id in the dome city); pearl-a/b/c at (16, -6 / -2 / 2) off its centre (SOCKET_FILL to -X, the rover's dock the author's 8 m -X, 3.9175 m -Z, facing -Z), pearl-d (stage 9) at (16, 6), the SAI-92 bay at (-1, 0) and the unit on its SOCKET_LANDING (y 0.215), all near LOD1 / far LOD2, none solid; the rover's pad at (-12, 0) facing the mouth. The programme: `depot` (automatic, sector 1 idle, after HUGIN), `pearl` (a board card, 2,000 kg x the board's index, from sector 3, last on the programme so the colony's own four cards come first; no perk: the glue reads the step done). Terminal (src/content/bestiary.js colony): YUSHI ROVER (3,600 kg, 'a second rover: not yet', no board card), YUSHI045 BIO-PEARL (board: 'pearl' draws the card's thumbnail, src/fx/board-thumbs.js), SAI-92 (採掘, mining to come); src/unitcatalog.js and src/lore.js entries; ASSETS.md and ATTRIBUTIONS.md rows. BUILD: scripts/build.mjs copies assets/models/yushi045/*.glb unpacked (gltfpack drops _YUSHI with -kv too: re-measured) and fails if dist/ has lost the attribute. THE NUMBERS, MEASURED: the design's rover (2,000 kg, 9 m/s, 150 / 300 kg/s) ran --rover's trip in 52.8 s out, 13.4 s harvest, 54.8 s back, 6.7 s unload over a 455 m road (the breach down the lane) and banked, on --ledger (sectors 1-2, the ideal defender, a flare on the richest ground whenever idle), 700 kg at sector 1's debrief and 3,454 at sector 2's, nothing rotted: the round-6 bar (about 6.3k kg at the board before sector 2) failed on the trip's clock, so the rot's pressure (the design's first lever) could not help. Resized: ROVER 6,000 kg, 16 m/s, 400 kg/s rake, 1,000 kg/s pour (--rover: 30.8 s out, 29.8 s harvest, 34.9 s back, 5.4 s unload, 5,437 kg over a 473 m road). --ledger, ROVER=flare at the first pile: S1 1,031 · S2 12,086 · S3 24,186 kg banked (base d67d5fb7: 11,996 · 36,380 · 107,019), 331 / 11,296 / 23,296 kg brought home, 59,196 kg rotted by S3. With a flagger that waits for 1,500 kg on the richest ground (FLAG_KG, the probe's option): S1 700 · S2 12,086 · S3 18,186, worse, so the probe flags the first pile by default. THE FIRST BOARD IS LEAN: on the base's road (~470 m to the breach down the lane) no 6,000 kg trip completes inside sector 1's 137 s once the ground is worth flagging, and the debrief and the board freeze the clock, so the board before sector 2 sees the jump's grants (700-1,031 kg) against round 6's 6.3k bar; from the board before sector 3 on it is fed (12,086 kg). Not fixed this round (the owner decides): a rover that lingers under a standing flare for the next bodies, a faster rover, or the dome city's depot in the NE court by the gate (stream C, a shorter road); the board's prices stay. Prices unchanged; three pearls of 12,000 kg (cap 36,000). SUITES: --rover green (kills on the ground and the bank still, the HUD's FIELD, F under the hull, the rover away in 54 ms wall, the field falls as its cargo rises, the hose while it pours, the bank up by the cargo and the pearls holding the bank, the fill shader fitted on all three, STORAGE FULL at 36,000 / 36,000 with the load kept aboard until a spend). --board green (its ideal defender now harvests at once, T.rover.collect()), --colony, --debrief, --opening, --ledger green. --companions red once on this branch (its hull drive at a K9 still wandering: passed 6.01 m off, no dodge) and green on the rerun and on the base snapshot of d67d5fb7 (both picked K0-TECH and saw its dodge): a flake in the dodge step's pick, not this branch. Not run (not in the stream's list): the long-standing base reds --gunship, --grow, --story, --story-world, --nest-guards, --defense.
alternatives: The design's rover numbers (2,000 kg, 9 m/s, 150 / 300 kg/s): overturned by --ledger, 700 kg at the first board; the owner may turn the four numbers in src/content/rover.js back down for a leaner harvest.
Lowering FIELD.decaySeconds' pressure first (the design's lever): nothing had rotted by sector 2, so it could not move the first boards; it is the lever for sector 3 on (59k kg rotted there).

The depot standing from the first frame of a bare page (stage 8 as 'standing at the start'): a bare page plans everything above stage 1 as pending, so a stage-8 island needs a programme step; the `depot` step after HUGIN prints it, and the opening's kills pay at once until it stands.

A perk `pearl` for the fourth pearl: the bestiary test wants every perk to open an entry and the board's thumbnail is found by perk; the step has no perk, the glue reads it done, the pearl's entry carries board: 'pearl'.
The fourth pearl before the launcher on the programme: crowded the launcher off the board's four structure cards (test/build-board.mjs); it stands last.
A real PointLight in each flare: every lit material recompiles when the light count changes; the glow is drawn.
Swapping the rover to its LOD2 beyond 150 m: the LOD2 is a frozen pose and would stop the wheels mid-trip; one LOD1 rover costs one model.
